title: Concept: Arithmetic overflow wraps silently in release builds
description: Cargo.toml declares a release profile that switches integer overflow checks off, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a release profile that switches integer overflow checks off.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Cargo.toml (cargo).
risk: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a release profile that switches integer overflow checks off.
